name: maqami-travel
description: Official MCP server for MAQAMI, a hotel and flight booking platform with 3M+ hotels. Search hotels and flights, read hotel details, then send the customer a secure checkout link on book.maqami.co. Remote Streamable HTTP endpoint, no API key required.

interface.shortDescription: Search hotels and flights, book on MAQAMI
interface.longDescription: Search hotels (3M+ hotels) and flights worldwide with live rates, read hotel details, amenities, photos and reviews, then hold the price and send the customer a secure checkout link on book.maqami.co, where they enter their details, pay and get confirmed. The MCP server never takes payment. No account or API key is needed to connect.
defaultPrompt: Find 4-star hotels in Lisbon for 2 adults from 12 to 15 May and compare the three best options.
